hunks.baseline: “Jacob. How’s the situation over there? You’re not hurt, are you?”
hunks.sol: “Jacob, how are things over there? You’re not hurt, are you?”

hunks.baseline: On the holographic TV, an East Asian female anchor with heavily made-up eyes was asking the question. The sturdy Black reporter stationed at the scene winked and answered.
hunks.sol: On the holographic TV, an East Asian anchor with heavy eye makeup put the question to a broad-shouldered Black reporter at the scene. He winked at the camera.

hunks.baseline: “Thanks to Jenny worrying about me, I’m safe and sound. Everyone else is fine, too.”
hunks.sol: “Thanks for worrying about me, Jenny. I’m fine, and so is everyone else.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course it does. No one was hurt, and the situation was wrapped up in an instant. Besides, this is Texas. Everyone here is tough, men and women alike.”
hunks.sol: “It is. No one was hurt, and the whole thing was over in no time. Besides, this is Texas. Everyone here is tough, men and women alike.”

hunks.baseline: “Haha. That’s a relief. But where is the hero who saved everyone in that dangerous situation?”
hunks.sol: “Haha. That’s a relief. But where’s the hero who saved everyone?”

hunks.baseline: “Jenny, I’m afraid I owe you and the viewers an apology. The hero who was supposed to grace today’s broadcast, Magic Johnson, has already left. I tried my best, but I couldn’t hold him back.”
hunks.sol: “Jenny, I owe you and our viewers an apology. Magic Johnson, the hero we hoped to have with us today, has already left. I did my best, but I couldn’t persuade him to stay.”

hunks.baseline: “He refused the interview and disappeared, saying he had something urgent to take care of. He looked so desperate that I thought he was going to meet a secret lover.”
hunks.sol: “He said something urgent had come up and turned down the interview. He looked so desperate to leave, I thought he was off to meet a secret lover.”

hunks.sol: “I see. Now, Jacob, about the exact cause of this Mutated Gate…”

hunks.baseline: Leaning against the sofa and watching the holographic TV, I absentmindedly began to hum.
hunks.sol: I leaned back on the sofa, watching the holographic TV, and found myself humming.

hunks.baseline: “When Dad goes to work, Ppoppo. Magic Johnson comes to Korea, Ppoppo.”[^1]
hunks.sol: “When Dad goes to work, Ppoppo Ppoppo. Magic Johnson comes to Korea, Ppoppo Ppoppo.”[^1]

hunks.baseline: I ducked at the sound of something slicing through the air, and a crystal glass narrowly grazed the back of my neck before smashing into the holographic TV.
hunks.sol: I ducked at the sound of something cutting through the air. A crystal glass skimmed the back of my neck and smashed into the holographic TV.

hunks.baseline: Shards flew in every direction, and water pooled across the floor. Team Leader Choi, whose eyes met mine, calmly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Shards flew everywhere, and water pooled across the floor. My eyes met Team Leader Choi’s. He spoke calmly.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, you dodged that.”
hunks.sol: “Oh. You dodged it.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m telling you this so you don’t misunderstand. It was intentional.”
hunks.sol: “In case you’re wondering, that was deliberate.”

hunks.baseline: “…You’re not even going to claim it was an accident?”
hunks.sol: “…You’re not even going to pretend it was an accident?”

hunks.baseline: “Because it wasn’t an accident. Still, it’s a real shame. If that had been just a little faster, it would’ve smashed Mr. Jin Taekyung’s skull…”
hunks.sol: “It wasn’t an accident. It’s a shame, though. A little faster and it would’ve hit your damn head…”

hunks.baseline: “Hey, you don’t call a person’s head a ‘skull.’ A skull?”
hunks.sol: “Hey, you can’t call someone’s head a *damn head*.”

hunks.baseline: “You keep flapping that obnoxious trap of yours, so yes, I’m calling it a skull. Frankly, even the word ‘skull’ is wasted on a blockhead like you.”
hunks.sol: “I can when you won’t stop running that damn mouth of yours. Frankly, even ‘head’ is too good a word for a blockhead like you.”

hunks.baseline: “Whoa, what? ‘Skull’? ‘Trap’?”
hunks.sol: “Whoa. ‘Damn head’? ‘Damn mouth’?”

hunks.baseline: “From now on, don’t even think about falling asleep in front of me. If you sleep with your mouth open, I’ll pour cyanide down it.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t fall asleep in front of me from now on. If you sleep with your mouth open, I’ll pour cyanide down it.”

hunks.baseline: Was that punchline insane or what?
hunks.sol: What the hell was that punchline?

hunks.baseline: He must have been furious. His words came out as if he were spitting them through clenched teeth, and the venom seeping through them left me momentarily speechless.
hunks.sol: He must have been furious. He practically spat the words, and the venom in them left me speechless for a moment.

hunks.baseline: I briefly considered taking out the Myriad-Poison Ring, then calmly waved a hand.
hunks.sol: I considered taking out the Myriad-Poison Ring, then politely waved a hand.

hunks.baseline: “Team Leader Choi. Calm down, calm down. I was completely wrong.”
hunks.sol: “Team Leader Choi. Calm down. This was all my fault.”

hunks.baseline: “Do I look like I can calm down right now?”
hunks.sol: “Do I look like I can calm down?”

hunks.baseline: “I couldn’t help it in that situation. You saw the news. They said he was busy dealing with a Mutated Gate. What else could I do? I had to get him here first.”
hunks.sol: “I’m telling you, I had no choice. You saw the news. He was busy with a Mutated Gate. What else could I do? I had to get him here first.”

hunks.baseline: “Even so, do you get to put my lips on the line without asking?”
hunks.sol: “By offering up my lips without asking me?”

hunks.baseline: “But I couldn’t put my own lips on the line, could I?”
hunks.sol: “But I couldn’t offer up my own lips, could I?”

hunks.baseline: Whoa. That one had genuinely been dangerous.
hunks.sol: Whoa. That one was actually close.

hunks.baseline: After narrowly dodging the attack once again, I hurriedly shouted.
“Stop! Team Leader! Stop!”
hunks.sol: I narrowly dodged again and shouted, “Stop! Team Leader, stop!”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi picked up a third crystal glass and answered.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi picked up a third crystal glass.

hunks.baseline: “Shut your mouth and stick your head out. Right there.”
hunks.sol: “Shut your mouth and hold still. Right there.”

hunks.baseline: “I didn’t kiss him! I didn’t do it in the end!”
hunks.sol: “You didn’t kiss him! It never happened!”

hunks.baseline: “You almost did!”
hunks.sol: “It almost did!”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was just about to swing his arm with a roar that could rival a lion’s roar when—
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was about to hurl the glass with a roar that rivaled a lion’s roar when—

hunks.baseline: The door opened without a knock.
In front of it stood the Skeleton King, brimming with anticipation, and Magic Johnson, looking thoroughly dejected.
hunks.sol: The door flew open without a knock. In the doorway stood the Skeleton King, brimming with anticipation, and Magic Johnson, looking dejected.

hunks.baseline: 「Choi, I’m a romantic too.」
hunks.sol: 「Choi, I have feelings too.」

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi stared silently at the club-obsessed parrot and the pure-hearted Grand Mage. Then, with a sigh, he lowered his hand.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi stared at the club-obsessed Skeleton King and the tenderhearted Grand Mage. Then he sighed and lowered his hand.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson was not merely an outstanding War Mage, but first and foremost a Grand Mage capable of wielding most forms of magic.
hunks.sol: Before he was an outstanding War Mage, Magic Johnson was a Grand Mage capable of wielding most forms of magic.

hunks.baseline: After receiving our call and coming straight to Korea, he heard everything from us.
hunks.sol: He had come straight to Korea after our call, and we’d told him the truth as soon as he arrived.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Johnson. There’s something we need to move, actually…”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Johnson. There’s something we need to move…”

hunks.baseline: “Whatever the reason, I want my Ppoppo first. You’re ready, Choi?”
hunks.sol: “Whatever the reason, I want my Ppoppo first. Ready, Choi?”

hunks.baseline: “Then that’s a problem. I don’t know what kind of object you’re trying to move in such strict secrecy, but…”
hunks.sol: “Then we have a problem. I don’t know what you’re trying to move in such secrecy, but…”

hunks.baseline: “Um, it isn’t an object. It’s a person, to be exact.”
hunks.sol: “Actually, it isn’t a thing. It’s a person.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m not sure whether ‘escape’ is the right word, but it’s similar.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know if ‘escape’ is the right word, but it’s something like that.”

hunks.baseline: “Who is it? A heinous criminal? Or a secret lover?”
hunks.sol: “Who is it? Some heinous criminal? A secret lover?”

hunks.baseline: “He’s my maternal grandfather.”
hunks.sol: “My maternal grandfather.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, shit. Sorry, Choi. I didn’t mean to—wait. Who did you just say?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, shit. Sorry, Choi. I didn’t mean to—wait. Who did you say?”

hunks.baseline: Even after hearing the entire story, Magic Johnson remained silent for a long time. He didn’t speak until he had personally confirmed Cheon Taemin’s face.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson had remained silent for a long time even after hearing the whole story. He didn’t speak again until he saw Cheon Taemin’s face for himself.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. What the hell happened here?”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. What the hell happened?”

hunks.baseline: “As you can see, it’s a dogshit situation.”
hunks.sol: “As you can see, it’s a shitty situation.”

hunks.baseline: “There was a reason you couldn’t explain everything over the phone. All right, let’s take care of the urgent matter first. Choi, where are we moving him from this prison-like place?”
hunks.sol: “So that’s why you couldn’t explain it over the phone. All right. Let’s deal with what’s urgent first. Choi, where do we need to move him from this prison?”

hunks.baseline: After that, everything proceeded at breakneck speed.
hunks.sol: After that, things moved quickly.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson cast Teleport using the coordinates Team Leader Choi had given him, and all of us—no, one person among us, locked in a deep sleep he could not easily wake from—was able to return to the mansion where he had once lived.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson cast Teleport to the coordinates Team Leader Choi gave him, and we all—no, one of us, trapped in a deep sleep he could hardly wake from—returned to the mansion where he had once lived.

hunks.baseline: It was a return more than twenty long years in the making.
hunks.sol: It had been more than twenty years.

hunks.baseline: 「Space distortion and barriers. Defensive magic is a given, and I’ve even set up humidity and temperature controls. And…」
hunks.sol: 「Space distortion, barriers, defensive magic, of course. I’ve set up humidity and temperature controls too. And…」

hunks.baseline: Like a traveler wandering across a beat, Magic Johnson rattled off every kind of magic without pause before finishing with a breathless sentence.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson rattled off spell after spell like a wanderer riding a beat, then finished in a breathless rush.

hunks.baseline: 「So, you can assume that I’ve taken every measure I’m currently capable of taking. Though additional work is still needed.」
hunks.sol: 「In short, I’ve done everything I can for now. There’s still more work to do, though.」

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King, sulking because he couldn’t go to a club, muttered.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King, sulking because he hadn’t gotten to go to a club, muttered, “I get that it’s impressive. How impressive?”

hunks.baseline: “I understand that it’s impressive, but how impressive are we talking?”
「It means that this place will remain intact unless a Grand Mage on my level—or two or three S-rank Hunters—deliberately attacks it with the intention of smashing it to pieces.」
hunks.sol: 「The place will hold unless a Grand Mage on my level—or two or three S-rank Hunters—sets out to smash it.」

hunks.baseline: “That’s some serious performance.”
hunks.sol: “That’ll do the job.”

hunks.baseline: I agreed with the Skeleton King. Magic Johnson had quite literally taken every measure he could.

hunks.sol: 「Probably not. Though I do have someone in mind.」

hunks.baseline: “Someone you have in mind?”
hunks.sol: “You do?”

[^1]: *Ppoppo* is Korean baby talk for a kiss. Taekyung is riffing on a children’s song associated with the Korean TV program *Ppoppo Ppoppo*.
[^2]: *Jotbap* is a vulgar Korean insult for a pushover; it contains *bap*, the word for cooked rice or a meal.
[^3]: *Gukbap* is rice served in hot soup. This version contains *sundae*, a Korean blood sausage.
